text:
maya: Heads up — this morning AES-1 saw ~40% GPU capacity degrade starting 2026-03-12T07:12Z due to noisy tenant + intermittent BGP flaps. We shifted traffic to SFO/LAX automatically but observed request queueing on low-tier pools. Not full outage but user-visible latency spikes. Opening thread to capture runbook gaps and follow-ups.

alex: Thanks Maya. Did the automated fallback use weighted shift or full cutover? Any errors in the autoscaler logs?

ops-bot: AutomatedFailoverBot: executed weighted shift: aes-1->sfo=60%,lax=40% at 07:14 UTC; KV-cache warmup job queued; alert: backend queue length > 200 for /v1/generate on aes-1

li: We did weighted shift. Problem: runbook has only "manual cutover" steps and a single "force cut" command — no guided weighted-shift instructions or throttled warmup.

sam: Observed one additional problem: dedicated low-tier pools didn't have pre-reserved warm capacity so even after shift SFO needed ~2min to spin up caches leading to latency.

jen: Proposal:
- Add explicit "weighted traffic shift" procedure with sample curl command
- Add "pre-warm KV cache" step (job id: kv-warm v2)
- Lower queue-length alert threshold in AES regions from 200->120 during business hours
- Add check for tenant isolation (noisy neighbors)

ACTION: I'll open a runbook PR with the above and link tests.

jen: sample commands to include (copy to runbook):
```bash
# shift weights gradually
curl -s -X POST https://infra-api.internal/route-shift \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"aes-1","target":{"sfo":80,"lax":20},"step_ms":30000}'

# pre-warm KV cache job
kubectl -n infra run kv-warm --image=infra/kv-warm:latest -- /bin/warm --targets aes-1 --concurrency 4
```

ricardo: Cost note: pre-reserving capacity and lowering thresholds will increase spend. We should add a quick T-shirt cost calc in PR. Recommend standard reserve for AES region of one N4 per zone during peak hours.

maya: +1 on cost calc. Also add rollback steps if the shift makes other regions degrade: command `infra-cli route reset aes-1` and fallback policy named `regional-fallback-v2`.

li: Test plan: schedule an offline drill to exercise weighted shift + kv-warm. 30-min window. Can we run on staging first? Need runbook section for "Drill -> Validation checks" with expected metrics (queue < 50, p95 latency < 300ms) and owners.

sam: ACTION: I'll schedule staging drill for 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC and add checklist to runbook. @jen please add owners for each step.

jen: Assigned: runbook PR -> #infra/runbooks (jen). Drill runbook checklist -> #ops-sre (sam). Cost calc -> ricardo. Post-incident writeup -> maya.

ops-bot: IncidentLogger: incident tagged: capacity-degradation-aes-1, severity: S2, start_ts: 1779001920

maya: Thanks all. I'll file the PR and ping reviewers. Let's close this thread after PR + staging drill scheduled.
